items.summary_zh: 小干扰RNA（siRNA）治疗的发展使其化学结构日益复杂，给结构表征带来了分析挑战。由于非典型骨架化学、各种化学修饰和附加结合物导致的异质性碎片化，使得通过串联质谱（MS/MS）进行自信的测序和特定位点修饰定位仍然困难。我们提出了一种无离子对的亲水性相互作用液相色谱-质谱（HILIC-MS/MS）工作流程，能够通过温控分离对结合的、重修饰的siRNA构建体进行非变性和变性分析。在非变性条件下，可以评估双链的治疗完整性和稳定性，而在高温下实现双链解离，允许对正义链和反义链进行色谱分离和MS/MS分析。该方法通过多种结构复杂性逐渐增加的siRNA治疗药物进行了基准测试，包括未结合的双链ATU027、patisiran、含扩展核酸（exNA）骨架的Huntingtin（HTT）靶向siRNA，以及GalNAc结合的siRNA药物fitusiran。

items.title: Acidic local environments inhibit CO2 reduction catalysis on coinage metals
items.abstract: The carbon-efficient electrochemical reduction of CO 2 (CO 2 RR) requires acidic electrolytes to mitigate irreversible CO 2 capture via non-faradaic CO 2 uptake and (bi)carbonate formation. However, CO 2 RR only takes place in acidic electrolytes upon addition of spectator cations and the mechanistic basis for this requirement remains unclear. Herein, we present scanning voltammetry experiments conducted in bulk acidic electrolytes in conjunction with differential electrochemical mass spectrometry (DEMS) analysis of CO 2 consumption and product formation. By quantifying both faradaic CO 2 consumption via CO 2 RR, and non-faradaic CO 2 consumption via the formation of (bi)carbonate in real-time, we deconvolute the direct role of the added electrolyte cations from their indirect role in fostering a transient local pH swing. We find that across coinage metals and electrolyte compositions, CO 2 RR commences only upon substantial depletion of hydronium and coincides with non-faradaic CO 2 uptake. Doping Ag with Pt to promote hydronium consumption via efficient H 2 evolution serves to lower the overpotential for CO 2 RR onset in scanning voltammetry experiments by ~1 V. These findings together indicate that an interfacial pH swing is a pre-requisite for, rather than merely a consequence of CO 2 RR, and that the primary role of the supporting electrolyte cations is to establish a non-equilibrium interfacial ionic environment depleted in hydronium ions. To rationalize these findings, we propose that acidic pH environments foster the formation of *COOH, rather than *COO − , and that this protonated intermediate undergoes unproductive fragmentation to CO 2 and H*, contributing to H 2 evolution, but not CO 2 RR. This work highlights the value of pre-steady state real-time analysis of both faradaic and non-faradaic interfacial reactions and establishes a self-consistent mechanistic picture for CO 2 RR in bulk acidic electrolyte.
items.authors: Max J. Hülsey, Bryan Y. Tang, Sophia Weng, Yogesh Surendranath
items.title_zh: 酸性环境抑制货币金属上的CO2还原催化
items.summary_zh: 二氧化碳的高效电化学还原（CO2 RR）需要酸性电解质，以减轻通过非法拉第过程捕获CO2及形成（生）碳酸盐的不可逆反应。然而，酸性电解质中添加旁观阳离子对CO2 RR的影响及其机制尚不清楚。本研究通过在体积酸性电解质中进行扫描伏安法实验，并结合差分电化学质谱（DEMS）分析CO2消耗和产物形成，定量分析了法拉第和非法拉第CO2消耗。结果表明，CO2 RR仅在氢离子显著耗竭后开始，并与非法拉第CO2吸收同时发生。用铂掺杂银以促进氢离子消耗可使CO2 RR的过电位降低约1 V。这些发现表明，界面pH波动是CO2 RR的前提，而非仅仅是其结果，支持电解质阳离子的主要作用是建立非-

items.title: Accelerating Proton Affinity Prediction with Multi-Fidelity Machine Learning
items.abstract: Accurate gas-phase proton affinities (PAs) are essential for designing proton carriers in anhydrous fuel cells, yet high-level quantum-chemical calculations are too expensive for large libraries. We develop a multi-fidelity Δ-learning framework that corrects PM7 semi-empirical estimates toward high-fidelity references using only PM7 electronic properties and cheminformatics descriptors, without DFT-derived features. On a 1,155-molecule NIST WebBook benchmark, an ExtraTrees model correction reduces the PM7 mean absolute error (MAE) from 8.21 to 2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol, a 47% reduction over a calibrated PM7 baseline of 5.44 ± 0.39 kcal/mol. A DFT-descriptor-based model trained to the same experimental targets yields 3.17 ± 0.24 kcal/mol, demonstrating that PM7-based features achieve comparable accuracy while avoiding DFT cost at inference. We extend Δ-learning to the harder task of site-specific prediction against a B3LYP/def2-TZVP reference, across 251 diverse molecules and 821 site-matched protonation sites, reducing the raw PM7 error from 10.26 to 7.44 ± 1.00 kcal/mol, versus 8.23 ± 1.02 kcal/mol for calibrated PM7. Functional-group and SHAP analyses identify correction patterns and high-variance cases where direct DFT remains preferable. We then apply the RandomForest model in a seven-stage workflow screening for candidate anhydrous proton carriers, combining similarity retrieval, PM7+Δ-ML prediction, Claude Opus 4.6-assisted preliminary donor–acceptor motif screening, and Pareto selection. From 821,435 filtered ZINC molecules, 30 candidates were DFT-validated, of which 29 fall within the target window (210–235 kcal/mol). Applied prospectively to these 30 molecules, the correction lowers the raw PM7 error from 13.51 to 3.99 kcal/mol. The DFT PA window, motif check, and functional-group exclusion retain 26 candidates, and the five ranked highest by DFT proton affinity span 226.6–234.3 kcal/mol, at or above the 225.3 kcal/mol PA of imidazole. These single-molecule calculations prioritize candidates for experiment but do not by themselves establish condensed-phase proton conductivity.
items.authors: Debjyoti Bhattacharya, Yifan Liu, Valentino R. Cooper, Wesley F. Reinhart
items.title_zh: 利用多保真度机器学习加速质子亲和力预测
items.summary_zh: 准确的气相质子亲和力（PAs）对无水燃料电池中质子载体的设计至关重要，但高水平的量子化学计算对于大规模库来说成本过高。我们开发了一种多保真度Δ学习框架，通过仅使用PM7电子性质和化学信息学描述符，纠正PM7半经验估计以接近高保真参考，而无需DFT派生特征。在1155个分子的NIST WebBook基准测试中，ExtraTrees模型的修正将PM7的平均绝对误差（MAE）从8.21降低到2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol，相较于经过校准的PM7基线5.44 ± 0.39 kcal/mol减少了47%。基于DFT描述符的模型在相同实验目标下的结果为3.17 ± 0.24 kcal/mol，表明PM7特征在推理时能够实现可比的准确性，同时避免DFT的高成本。我们将Δ学习扩展到更困难的特定位点预测任务，针对B3LYP/def2-TZVP参考，在251种不同分子和821个匹配的质子化位点上，将原始PM7误差从10.26降低到7.44 ± 1.00 kcal/mol，而校准PM7为8.23 ± 1.02 kcal/mol。功能团和SHAP分析识别了修正模式和高方差案例，其中直接DFT仍然更可取。随后，我们在七阶段工作流程中应用RandomForest模型筛选候选无水质子载体，结合相似性检索。

items.title: Microwave electric field-induced dynamic hydration enables selected dehydration of formic acid over a poly(m-phenolsulfonic acid–formaldehyde Catalyst
items.abstract: Formic acid is a promising renewable C1 feedstock and a safe liquid precursor for on-demand carbon monoxide (CO) production. However, selective dehydration of formic acid to CO remains challenging because solid acid catalysts generally require high temperatures and suffer from competing dehydrogenation and water-induced inhibition of acid sites. Here, we report the selective dehydration of formic acid over a poly(m-phenolsulfonic acid–formaldehyde) (PAFR II) catalyst under microwave irradiation. PAFR II afforded CO in 65% yield at 120 C without detectable formation of hydrogen or carbon dioxide. The catalyst was reused three times while maintaining selective CO formation. PAFR II showed stable catalytic activity during continuousflow dehydration, exhibiting a CO productivity of 31–37 mmol g-1 h-1. This activity was higher than that of previously reported solid acid catalysts operating at or below 150 °C. The resulting CO was directly used for the alkoxycarbonylation of iodobenzene to afford propyl benzoate in 92% yield, demonstrating the practical applicability of this system as an on-demand CO source. Water-addition experiments showed that adsorbed water strongly inhibited dehydration. Microwave electric-field irradiation afforded substantially higher activity than magnetic-field irradiation and conventional heating. Fourier-transform infrared difference spectroscopy and phase-resolved modulation infrared spectroscopy revealed reversible changes in adsorbed water around the sulfonic acid moieties under microwave irradiation. These results suggest that the microwave electric field dynamically modulates the hydration structure around the acid sites, temporarily increasing their accessibility to formic acid.
items.authors: Hidenori Nishio, Aya Ohno, Nobutaka Maeda, Abbas B. Askari, Keiichiro Kashimura, Takeshi Miyata
items.title_zh: 微波电场诱导动态水合实现甲酸的选择性脱水
items.summary_zh: 甲酸是一种有前景的可再生C1原料和安全的液体前驱体，用于按需生产一氧化碳（CO）。然而，甲酸的选择性脱水至CO仍然具有挑战性，因为固体酸催化剂通常需要高温，并且面临竞争性脱氢和水引起的酸位点抑制。本文报道了在微波辐射下，使用聚（m-苯磺酸-甲醛）催化剂（PAFR II）实现甲酸的选择性脱水。PAFR II在120°C下以65%的产率生成CO，且未检测到氢或二氧化碳的生成。该催化剂可重复使用三次，保持选择性CO生成。在连续流脱水过程中，PAFR II表现出稳定的催化活性，CO生产率为31-37 mmol g-1 h-1，优于以150°C或更低温度运行的先前报道的固体酸催化剂。生成的CO被直接用于碘苯的烷氧基羧基化反应，产率达到92%，展示了该系统作为按需CO源的实际应用性。水添加实验表明，吸附水强烈抑制脱水反应。微波电场辐射的活性显著高于磁场辐射和传统加热。

items.title: Graph Neural Networks for Accelerated Prediction of Excited-State Properties in Transition-Metal Complexes
items.abstract: Machine learning (ML) has been increasingly applied to the ground-state properties of transition-metal complexes (TMCs), whereas its use for predicting their stateresolved photophysical properties remains comparatively limited. Here, we evaluate nine ML configurations: a descriptor-based XGBoost model and eight graph neural network (GNN) configurations, using excited-state reference data from tmQMg* together with molecular, structural, and electronic information from the tmQM dataset series. The models were trained to predict the 30 lowest vertical singlet excitations, including excitation energies (∆E), oscillator strengths ( f ), absorption properties, charge-transfer (CT) character, and the metal contributions to the occupied and virtual natural transition orbitals (NTOs). GNNs substantially outperformed XGBoost for ∆E. Among the investigated architectures, the polarizable atom interaction neural network (PaiNN) provided the most favorable balance between accuracy and input requirements, reproducing ∆E with a mean absolute error of 0.124 eV while requiring only an XYZ file and formal molecular charge. Furthermore, PaiNN reliably captured excited-state character, resulting in 87.0% accuracy for CT classification and occupied-and virtual-NTO metal-fraction MAEs of 0.082 and 0.058, respectively, indicating that it generally distinguishes metal-and ligand-centered orbital character well. Individual f values were more difficult to predict accurately; however, combining the predicted ∆E and intensities reproduced the principal features of the broadened absorption spectra. Overall, these results establish PaiNN as a fast and reliable predictor of multiple TMC excited-state properties from minimal molecular input, providing a practical route for large-scale photophysical screening and substantially reducing the need for time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) calculations and subsequent excited-state analysis.
items.authors: Ismael A. Elayan, J. Diego Castro-Miyashiro, J. Terence Blaskovits
items.title_zh: 图神经网络加速预测过渡金属配合物激发态性质
items.summary_zh: 机器学习（ML）在过渡金属配合物（TMCs）的基态性质预测中应用日益广泛，但在激发态光物理性质预测方面仍相对有限。本文评估了九种机器学习配置，包括基于描述符的XGBoost模型和八种图神经网络（GNN）配置，利用来自tmQMg*的激发态参考数据以及tmQM数据集系列的分子、结构和电子信息。模型训练旨在预测30个最低垂直单重激发，包括激发能（∆E）、振荡强度（f）、吸收性质、电荷转移（CT）特征，以及金属对占据和虚拟自然跃迁轨道（NTOs）的贡献。GNN在∆E预测上显著优于XGBoost。在研究的架构中，极化原子相互作用神经网络（PaiNN）在准确性和输入要求之间提供了最佳平衡，∆E的平均绝对误差为0.124 eV，仅需XYZ文件和分子正式电荷。此外，PaiNN可靠捕捉激发态特征，CT分类准确率达到87.0%，占据和虚拟NTO金属分数的MAE分别为0.082和0.058，表明其能够有效区分金属和配体中心的轨道特征。

items.title: Coordination Alone Does Not Passivate Surface Halide-Vacancy States in Lead Halide Perovskites
items.abstract: Molecular passivation of halide vacancies at lead-halide perovskite surfaces is conventionally attributed to Lewis-base coordination of undercoordinated Pb2+ sites. Density functional theory with spin–orbit coupling on FA0.75MA0.25PbI3 (001) shows this premise is electronically insufficient. Across ten additives, no coordination metric predicts which additives passivate: molybdic acid coordinates at 2.346 Å (−1.14 e) yet leaves the localized Pb(6p) defect trap intact (p = 0.128; +0.29 eV in HSE06), whereas permanganic acid coordinates at 2.156 Å (−1.06 e) and clears it (p ≤ 0.002). The outcomes exhibit discrete bimodal separation (Ashman’s D = 23.11) governed by specific interfacial chemistry: proton transfer forming a hydridic Pb–H bond (H2SO4, p = 0.008) or charge-transfer depopulation into an accessible acceptor manifold (HMnO4). This mechanism rationalizes the observed processing sensitivity of phosphate additives. Screening additives by coordination geometry cannot identify passivants; targeting proton delivery or redox-accessible acceptor levels can.
items.authors: Christopher Gaspar Msigwa, Muhammad Mateen, Shibing Chu
items.title_zh: 仅靠配位无法钝化铅卤钙钛矿表面卤素缺陷态
items.summary_zh: 铅卤钙钛矿表面卤素缺陷的分子钝化通常归因于对配位不足的Pb2+位点的路易斯碱配位。通过对FA0.75MA0.25PbI3 (001)进行自旋-轨道耦合的密度泛函理论计算，发现这一假设在电子上是不充分的。在十种添加剂中，没有任何配位指标能够预测哪些添加剂能够钝化：钼酸在2.346 Å处配位（−1.14 e），但保留了局域Pb(6p)缺陷陷阱（p = 0.128；+0.29 eV在HSE06中），而高锰酸则在2.156 Å处配位（−1.06 e），并清除了该缺陷（p ≤ 0.002）。结果显示出离散的双峰分离（Ashman’s D = 23.11），由特定的界面化学主导：质子转移形成氢化Pb–H键（H2SO4，p = 0.008）或电荷转移去除到可接收的受体能级（HMnO4）。该机制解释了磷酸盐添加剂的加工敏感性。通过配位几何筛选添加剂无法识别钝化剂；而针对质子输送或可氧化还原受体能级的靶向则可以。

items.title: Manifestation of van der Waals interactions in the vibrational spectra of alkali metal dimers.
items.abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis of the vibrational frequencies of alkali metal dimers from Li2 to Cs2 in the ground electronic state X 1Σ+ g, with the aim of identifying manifestation of van der Waals interactions at high vibrational excitation. Based on literature data on the energies of the vibrational levels G(v), vibrational frequency functions have been constructed: the first difference G1(v), representing the sequence of vibrational quanta (G1(v) 0), and the second difference G2(v), representing the rate of decrease in their energy (G2(v) 0). For five dimers, these functions have a similar form. The function G1(v) decreases monotonically with acceleration, and concavity appears near the asymptote. The function G2(v) increases in magnitude with acceleration up to an inflection point, where it undergoes a rapid decrease, forming the so-called tail. It is shown that, for the tail levels, the turning points r2 correspond to the van der Waals pair state. Since the excited molecule spends the maximum amount of time in the vicinity of the outer classical inflection point r2, at these energy levels the interatomic distances of ~3.5 Å (Li2)–~3.1 Å (Cs2) exceeds twice the van der Waals radius of the atom. It can be assumed that the valence contribution is small in these states. The main conclusion of this work is that a qualitative change in G2(v) for alkali metal dimers occurs in the same region of the potential well U(r), including the tail. The transition to van der Waals interaction occurs at a constant distance from the asymptote of approximately 120 cm-1, or, possibly, varying from 120 to 90 cm-1 in the studied series of molecules.
items.authors: Gleb S. Denisov
items.title_zh: 碱金属二聚体振动光谱中的范德瓦尔斯相互作用表现
items.summary_zh: 本文分析了从Li2到Cs2的碱金属二聚体在基态X 1Σ+ g下的振动频率，旨在识别高振动激发下范德瓦尔斯相互作用的表现。基于文献中振动能级G(v)的数据，构建了振动频率函数：第一差分G1(v)表示振动量子序列，第二差分G2(v)表示能量下降速率。对于五个二聚体，这些函数呈现相似形式。G1(v)单调递减并加速，接近渐近线时出现凹性。G2(v)在加速下增大至拐点后迅速下降，形成所谓的尾部。结果表明，尾部能级的转折点r2对应于范德瓦尔斯对态。在这些能量水平下，激发分子在外部经典拐点r2附近停留时间最长，原子间距约为~3.5 Å（Li2）至~3.1 Å（Cs2），超过原子范德瓦尔斯半径的两倍，推测在这些状态下价电子贡献较小。主要结论是碱金属二聚体的G2(v)发生了定性变化。

items.title: Validated thin-film microextraction-GC-MS reveals volatile metabolite signatures of Acinetobacter baumannii - Candida albicans interactions relevant to polymicrobial infection research
items.abstract: Background: Microbial volatile organic compounds (VOCs) may provide information on pathogenspecific metabolism and interspecies interactions, but their reliable characterization as potential indicators for diagnosis of emerging infections requires a robust analytical workflow. This study developed an in-house hydrophilic-lipophilic balanced (HLB) thin-film microextraction gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (TFME-GC-MS) workflow for dynamic VOC profiling of Acinetobacter baumannii, Candida albicans, and their mixed culture, to evaluate its applicability to microbial metabolomics in pre-clinical biomarker discovery. Methods: The workflow was optimized and subjected to validation using a panel of 20 VOCs in tryptic soy broth. The method showed compound-dependent analytical performance suitable for comparative microbial volatilomics, with negligible carryover and sufficient sensitivity for profiling dynamic VOC changes. Results: Application to mono- and co-cultures revealed distinct temporal VOC patterns associated with bacterial, fungal, and interaction-dependent metabolism. The multivariate analysis indicated that among the 145 VOCs monitored, 57 showed significant changes in A. baumannii cultures and 60 in C. albicans cultures, while 33 compounds supported differentiation of the investigated culture types based on VIP scores. The co-cultivation produced a VOC profile that could not be accounted for by summing the volatilomes of the individual monocultures, indicating metabolic interactions among the microorganisms. Calibration-based analysis of selected target VOCs further supported the profiling results for representative compounds. Conclusions: The proposed TFME-GC-MS method is a useful pharmaceutical-analysis tool for preclinical prioritization of volatile biomarker candidates relevant to future studies of polymicrobial infections.
items.authors: Karolina Żuchowska, Wojciech Filipiak, Dagmara Depka-Radzikowska, Tomasz Bogiel, Karol Jaroch, Barbara Bojko
items.title_zh: 薄膜微萃取-GC-MS揭示嗜麦芽窄食单胞菌与白色念珠菌的挥发性代谢物特征
items.summary_zh: 背景：微生物挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）可提供病原体特异性代谢和物种间相互作用的信息，但其作为新兴感染诊断潜在指标的可靠特征化需要强大的分析工作流程。本研究开发了一种自制的亲水-疏水平衡（HLB）薄膜微萃取气相色谱-质谱（TFME-GC-MS）工作流程，用于嗜麦芽窄食单胞菌、白色念珠菌及其混合培养的动态VOCs分析，以评估其在临床前生物标志物发现中的适用性。方法：该工作流程经过优化并使用20种VOCs在胰蛋白胨大豆肉汤中进行验证。结果显示，该方法具有适合比较微生物挥发组学的化合物依赖性分析性能，具有可忽略的残留和足够的灵敏度以分析动态VOCs变化。结果：对单培养和共培养的应用揭示了与细菌、真菌及相互作用依赖性代谢相关的明显时间性VOCs模式。多变量分析显示，在监测的145种VOCs中，57种在A. baumannii培养中显著变化，60种在C. albicans培养中变化，33种化合物支持基于VIP评分的培养类型区分。共培养产生的VOCs谱图显示出独特特征。

items.title: Magnetic Control of NIR Lanthanide Emission in Molecular Complexes
items.abstract: Magnetic modulation of luminescence has not been realized in molecular lanthanide complexes, whose spin–orbit coupled 4f excited states are well shielded from external perturbations. Here, we report molecular lanthanide complexes whose photoluminescence is controllably modulated by a magnetic field below 1 T through the spin dynamics of spin-correlated radical pairs (SCRPs). SCRPs, generated by photoexcitation of donor–bridge–acceptor molecules, undergo spin-selective radical pair recombination, thereby gating the energy-transfer pathway to the emissive lanthanide center (Ln 3+ ) through a pendant triplet acceptor in Ln 3+ complexes. Application of an external magnetic field alters the singlet–triplet SCRP interconversion, leading to field-dependent modulation of Ln 3+ emission intensity by up to 50%. This effect is observed at room temperature and is fully reversible. The successful demonstration of SCRP-mediated magnetic control of the Ln 3+ emission establishes a new design paradigm for magneto-responsive lanthanide materials and identifies SCRPs as viable quantum control elements for f-element luminescence.
items.authors: Ashly Gasior, Savana Correll, Saizhen Hu, Duohui Yan, Noen Jian, Tomoyasu Mani
items.title_zh: 分子复合物中近红外镧系元素发光的磁控研究
items.summary_zh: 在分子镧系元素复合物中，尚未实现荧光的磁调制，因为其自旋-轨道耦合的4f激发态受到外部扰动的良好屏蔽。本文报道了一类分子镧系元素复合物，其光致发光可通过自旋相关自由基对（SCRPs）的自旋动力学在1 T以下的磁场中可控调制。SCRPs由供体-桥-受体分子的光激发产生，经历自旋选择性自由基对重组，从而通过镧系中心（Ln³⁺）中的侧链三重态受体调控能量转移路径。施加外部磁场改变单态-三重态SCRP的相互转化，导致Ln³⁺发光强度的场依赖性调制，最高可达50%。该效应在室温下观察到，且完全可逆。SCRP介导的Ln³⁺发光的磁控成功展示，为磁响应镧系材料的设计提供了新范式，并将SCRPs确定为f元素荧光的可行量子控制元件。

items.title: ONE-POT SUFEX–HWE REACTION: A THREE-COMPONENT ENTRY TO ALKENYL SULFONAMIDES IN BATCH AND PARALLEL SYNTHESIS
items.abstract: A robust one-pot sulfur(VI) fluoride exchange – Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (SuFEx–HWE) reaction was developed as a direct three-component entry to α,β-unsaturated (alkenyl) sulfonamides, an electrophilic warhead class of growing importance in covalent drug discovery. The key reagent, diethyl [(fluorosulfonyl)methyl]phosphonate, was prepared in four steps and obtained on a 70 g scale in a single run. Control experiments established that the amine reacted first at the sulfonyl fluoride (SuFEx), and the resulting α-phosphonyl sulfonamide then underwent condensation with the aldehyde, so that a single operation at rt converted an aldehyde, an amine, and the phosphonate into the alkenyl sulfonamide with complete Eselectivity. Optimization identified DBU (3 equiv.) – LiCl (2 equiv.) in MeCN as the batch conditions (up to 94% yield), whereas iPr2NEt proved to be more general for the compound library synthesis. In a uniform 520reaction parallel set-up, the two protocols gave synthesis success rates of 52% and 65%, respectively. Aliphatic amines and (hetero)aromatic aldehydes were the most productive reaction partners. Heteroaromatic amines demonstrated poor performance that could be somewhat improved by changing the base. In the case of aliphatic aldehydes, the results were also modest, and they could not be altered by the base variation. A homologous reagent bearing an α-methyl group extended the method to trisubstituted alkenyl sulfonamides (88 library members, 79% success rate on the optimal substrate set), albeit with moderate E/Z selectivity.
items.authors: Iryna P. Drozd, Maksym V. Kovalov, Vasyl Naumchyk, Illia O. Doroshenko, Bohdan V. Vashchenko, Dmytro S. Radchenko
items.title_zh: 一锅法SUFEX-HWE反应：三组分合成烯基磺酰胺
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种稳健的一锅法硫(VI)氟交换-霍纳-瓦兹沃斯-埃蒙斯(SuFEx-HWE)反应，作为直接合成α,β-不饱和(烯基)磺酰胺的三组分方法，这类化合物在共价药物发现中日益重要。关键试剂二乙基[(氟磺酰)甲基]磷酸酯通过四步合成，单次反应获得70克。控制实验表明，胺首先与磺酰氟反应(SuFEx)，生成的α-磷酸酯磺酰胺随后与醛发生缩合，最终在室温下将醛、胺和磷酸酯转化为烯基磺酰胺，E选择性达到100%。优化条件为在MeCN中使用DBU(3当量)-LiCl(2当量)，产率可达94%；而iPr2NEt则更适合化合物库合成。在统一的520反应平行设置中，两种方案的合成成功率分别为52%和65%。脂肪胺和(杂)芳香醛是最有效的反应伙伴，杂芳胺表现较差，但通过更换碱可稍有改善。脂肪醛的结果也较为一般，且无法通过碱的变化进行调整。

items.title: The Graph Fourier Transform Recasts Rouse Modes to Encode Polymer Sequence
items.abstract: Rouse modes diagonalize the polymer connectivity matrix to describe how conformational motion is distributed over structural modes, yet the chemistry distributed along that same chain is traditionally encoded through hand-crafted, system-specific descriptors. Here, we generalize Rouse modes from bead coordinates to bead identity through a Graph Fourier Transform (GFT), which projects a chemically specific sequence signal onto the eigenbasis of the polymer graph Laplacian. The correspondence is exact for the combinatorial Laplacian, and holds by close analogy for its degree-weighted normalized counterpart. GFT descriptors predict the radius of gyration of architecturally diverse coarse-grained copolymers with accuracy comparable to a bespoke graph neural network and, with only the signal redefined, resolve liquid-liquid phase separation propensity in intrinsically disordered proteins. Predictive performance degrades with the degeneracy introduced by symmetric architectures. Generalized Rouse modes thus offer an architecture-adaptive and interpretable alternative to bespoke descriptors for sequence-controlled macromolecules.
items.authors: Viviana Palacio-Betancur, Nicholas E. Jackson
items.title_zh: 图谱傅里叶变换重构Rouse模式以编码聚合物序列
items.summary_zh: Rouse模式通过对聚合物连接矩阵进行对角化，描述了构象运动在结构模式上的分布。然而，传统上沿链分布的化学信息是通过手工设计的系统特定描述符来编码的。本文通过图谱傅里叶变换（GFT）将Rouse模式从珠子坐标推广到珠子身份，将化学特定序列信号投影到聚合物图拉普拉斯算子的特征基上。对于组合拉普拉斯算子，这种对应关系是精确的，并且对于其度加权归一化对应物也有相似的效果。GFT描述符在预测结构多样的粗粒度共聚物的回转半径方面，准确性与定制图神经网络相当，并且仅通过重新定义信号，能够解析内源性无序蛋白质的液-液相分离倾向。随着对称结构引入的简并性，预测性能有所下降。因此，广义Rouse模式为序列控制的大分子提供了一种适应架构且可解释的替代方案。

items.title: Extending AIMNet2 to Macrocyclic Peptides Through Data-Efficient Continual Training
items.abstract: Macrocyclic peptides are among the most promising therapeutic modalities, yet no general-purpose machine learned interatomic potential (MLIP) has been validated for their conformational analysis. We show that AIMNet2 matches the accuracy of MACE-OFF23(S) on the MPCONF196 macrocyclic benchmark, despite macrocycles being entirely absent from its training data, at three-to sixfold lower computational cost. To close the remaining accuracy gap, we introduce a continual training protocol that integrates fewer than 25,000 domain-specific conformers ( 0.1% of the training corpus) while preserving accuracy on non-macrocyclic molecules, reducing macrocyclic conformational energy RMSE by 25–27%. Applied to cyclosporine A as an independent test case, the continually trained model reproduces DFT conformational energies with sub-kcal mol −1 accuracy (RMSE 0.78 kcal mol −1 ) and correct rank ordering of all metastable conformers, outperforming all other tested MLIPs and semi-empirical methods. This continual training strategy, together with expanded non-covalent interaction coverage, has been adopted in the AIMNet2 (2025) release, which unifies small-molecule, macrocyclic, and intermolecular interaction treatment in a single production potential.
items.authors: Runtian Gao, Roman Zubatyuk, Olexandr Isayev
items.title_zh: 通过数据高效的持续训练扩展AIMNet2至大环肽
items.summary_zh: 大环肽是最有前景的治疗手段之一，但尚未有通用的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）被验证用于其构象分析。我们展示了AIMNet2在MPCONF196大环基准测试中，尽管训练数据中完全缺乏大环肽，其准确性仍与MACE-OFF23(S)相当，且计算成本降低了三到六倍。为缩小剩余的准确性差距，我们引入了一种持续训练协议，整合了不到25,000个特定领域的构象（占训练语料的0.1%），同时保持对非大环分子的准确性，减少了大环构象能量的均方根误差（RMSE）25-27%。在环孢素A的独立测试中，持续训练的模型以亚千卡每摩尔的准确性（RMSE 0.78 kcal mol−1）再现了DFT构象能量，并正确排序了所有亚稳态构象，优于所有其他测试的MLIP和半经验方法。这种持续训练策略以及扩展的非共价相互作用覆盖已在AIMNet2（2025）版本中采用，实现了小分子、大环和分子间相互作用的统一处理。

items.title: PolyReader: an agentic LLM pipeline for extracting structured data from unstructured polymer scientific literature
items.abstract: Machine learning for polymer design requires structured, sample-level records linking polymer identity, synthesis, composition, molecular-weight characteristics, processing conditions, and measured properties. Yet decades of polymer data remain dispersed across the texts, tables, figures, and supporting information of the literature, where individual values are often separated from the samples and experimental context they describe. Here we introduce PolyReader, an LLM agent for provenance-aware extraction of polymer data from scientific papers. Rather than treating a paper as a single block of text, PolyReader represents the manuscript and supporting information as navigable hierarchical section trees. The agent surveys this structure, selectively reads relevant pages, follows cross-references between documents, and integrates dispersed evidence into schema-validated, per-sample records. The resulting extracted fields are thus linked to its source document and page. On a benchmark of 42 polymer papers evaluated by trained annotators, PolyReader achieved F1 scores of 0.92–0.96 across 11 property categories, with comparable performance across three LLM models. Holding the LLM model, parsed document representation, and output schema fixed, PolyReader improved F1 by 13–17 points over single-pass prompting. These results show that reliable polymer-data extraction depends not only on recognizing individual values, but on reconstructing the sample-level relationships distributed throughout a paper. PolyReader produces records that are directly auditable against the primary literature, providing a scalable foundation for constructing traceable polymer datasets for machine learning. The extraction pipeline and benchmark annotations are released for reuse in the community.
items.authors: Yuwei Shi, Xinyan Zhong, Yuqi Wei, Heechae Choi, Tianhang Zhou, Zhenghao Wu
items.title_zh: PolyReader：提取聚合物科学文献结构数据的智能LLM管道
items.summary_zh: 聚合物设计的机器学习需要结构化的样本级记录，链接聚合物身份、合成、成分、分子量特征、加工条件和测量属性。然而，数十年的聚合物数据仍分散在文献的文本、表格、图形和支持信息中，个别数值常常与其描述的样本和实验背景分离。本文介绍了PolyReader，一种用于从科学论文中提取聚合物数据的LLM代理。PolyReader将手稿和支持信息表示为可导航的层次结构树，选择性地阅读相关页面，跟踪文档间的交叉引用，并将分散的证据整合为经过模式验证的样本记录。在42篇聚合物论文的基准测试中，PolyReader在11个属性类别中实现了0.92-0.96的F1分数，三种LLM模型的表现相当。通过固定LLM模型、解析文档表示和输出模式，PolyReader在单次提示上提高了13-17个F1点。这些结果表明，可靠的聚合物数据提取不仅依赖于单一因素。

items.title: Transfer learning guides discovery of NIR-emissive DNA-stabilized silver nanoclusters
items.abstract: Water-soluble near-infrared (NIR) emitters are of interest for imaging in the tissue transparency window. DNA-stabilized silver nanoclusters (DNA-AgN) hold promise for this spectral window, but it remains challenging to select oligonucleotides that stabilize NIR-emitting DNA-AgN. We address this challenge using transfer learning (TL), constructing a model that learns from experimental data for DNA-AgN stabilized by short 10-base oligonucleotides to then design longer oligonucleotides for larger, NIR-emitting nanoclusters. Using this model, we experimentally uncover 321 new DNA-AgN with peak emission beyond 800 nm, increasing design success by 710%. DNA-AgN designed using TL exhibit favorable properties including substantial emission above 1,000 nm, high fluorescence quantum yield, upconversion fluorescence, and a 14-electron count - the highest reported for DNA-AgN. These results demonstrate the power of TL for extracting physiochemical information from a limited parameter space and extrapolating these principles for broader design challenges, which is especially important when training data is scarce.
items.authors: Anthea Segger, Peter Mastracco, I-Hsin Lin, Kylie Lytle, Anna Gonzàlez-Rosell, Vanessa Rück
items.title_zh: 迁移学习指导NIR发射DNA稳定银纳米簇的发现
items.summary_zh: 水溶性近红外（NIR）发射体在组织透明窗口成像中具有重要意义。DNA稳定的银纳米簇（DNA-AgN）在该光谱窗口中展现出潜力，但选择能够稳定NIR发射DNA-AgN的寡核苷酸仍然具有挑战性。我们采用迁移学习（TL）解决这一问题，构建了一个模型，该模型从短10碱基寡核苷酸稳定的DNA-AgN的实验数据中学习，进而设计用于更大NIR发射纳米簇的长寡核苷酸。通过该模型，我们实验性地发现了321种新的DNA-AgN，其峰值发射超过800 nm，设计成功率提高了710%。使用TL设计的DNA-AgN展现出优良特性，包括在1000 nm以上的显著发射、高荧光量子产率、上转换荧光以及14电子计数——这是DNA-AgN中报告的最高值。这些结果展示了TL在有限参数空间中提取物理化学信息并将这些原则外推至更广泛设计挑战中的潜力，尤其在训练数据稀缺时尤为重要。

items.title: DEEP LEARNING HELMHOLTZ ENERGIES FOR THERMODYNAMIC PROPERTY PREDICTION
items.abstract: Based on SAFT equations of state (EoS), we propose a physics informed neural network that learns the residual Helmholtz free energy, yielding pressure, chemical potentials, entropy, and phase equilibria by automatic differentiation. Transport properties are connected through additional relations. The model can be pretrained on synthetic EoS data and fine-tuned with heterogeneous experimental data. The model operates on logarithmic scale and is designed to stabilize learning properties that span several orders of magnitude between phases, state points, and molecules. A differentiable transport model further allows viscosity and self-diffusion data to learn the temperature derivative of the Helmholtz energy during fine-tuning. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune the model to experimental temperature–pressure–density, viscosity, and self-diffusion data for water. Despite using only state point information and transport data for this single, particularly challenging fluid, the model predicts vapor pressure, vaporization enthalpy, density and entropy anomalies, and the critical temperature without direct exposure to these properties during fine-tuning. This demonstrates that jointly learning Helmholtz energies and transport coefficients is viable and beneficial. We argue that such Helmholtz energy centered, data driven deep learning models provide an alternative to the current proliferation of isolated, single property machine learning solutions. Generalization to unseen molecules and a fixed functional mode with optimized molecule representation parameters are also demonstrated.
items.authors: Maximilian Fleck, Marcelle B M Spera
items.title_zh: 深度学习海尔姆霍兹自由能用于热力学性质预测
items.summary_zh: 基于SAFT状态方程，我们提出了一种物理信息神经网络，学习残余海尔姆霍兹自由能，通过自动微分获得压力、化学势、熵和相平衡。模型可在合成EoS数据上进行预训练，并通过异质实验数据进行微调。该模型在对数尺度上运行，旨在稳定跨越多个数量级的学习特性。可微分的传输模型进一步允许在微调过程中利用粘度和自扩散数据学习海尔姆霍兹能量的温度导数。作为概念验证，我们将模型微调至水的实验温度-压力-密度、粘度和自扩散数据。尽管仅使用状态点信息和传输数据，该模型仍能预测蒸汽压力、蒸发焓、密度和熵异常以及临界温度，且在微调过程中未直接接触这些性质。这表明联合学习海尔姆霍兹能量和传输系数是可行且有益的。

items.title: Machine-Learned Potentials for Accelerated CCSD(T)-level Evaluations: Applications to OH(H2O)n
items.abstract: An end-to-end machine learning workflow for the development of potential energy surfaces at the DLPNO-CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ level is described and applied to hydroxide-water complexes with two to five water molecules. This workflow utilizes a two-part machine learning process, achieving both accuracy and efficiency by combining a molecular orbital-based machine learning (MOB-ML) model with a GPU-accelerated equivariant graph neural network (EGNN) model. For both machine learning models trained in this workflow, the training data is obtained through the combination of small diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) simulations initiated at each of the optimized structures of interest for a given system size. A farthest point sampling algorithm based on a principal component analysis is employed to generate a diverse set of geometries that spans configuration space, including transition states. By transforming Cartesian coordinates into a graph-based representation, the EGNN model eliminates additional preprocessing of molecular configurations, provides an unbiased treatment of multiple isomers, and allows for isomerization processes among the isomers. An error analysis is performed on the final EGNN models, comparing the potential energies predicted for optimized structures, transition states, and structures that are obtained from snapshots of the ground state wave function sampled by large-scale DMC simulations to those evaluated at the DLPNO-CCSD(T)/aug-ccpVTZ level of theory and basis. Finally, production-run DMC simulations are performed using the validated potentials for both the OH(H 2 O) 2-5 and OD(D 2 O) 2-5 systems, and an analysis of the relative anharmonic zero-point energies is performed. It is found that deuteration does not change the relative energy ordering of the isomers of the OH(H 2 O) 3-5 complexes. Evidence of proton delocalization is identified in the prism isomer of OH(H 2 O) 5 in which a hydrogen atom in one of the solvating water molecules is found to be, on average, equidistant from the oxygen atoms in the hydroxide ion and the hydrogen-bonded water molecule. This delocalization is found to be retained with full deuteration of this complex.
items.authors: Greta M. Jacobson, Chenrui Shao, Tanya I. Bakalov, Lixue Cheng, Anne B. McCoy
items.title_zh: 加速CCSD(T)级别评估的机器学习势能研究：OH(H2O)n的应用
items.summary_zh: 本文描述了一种端到端的机器学习工作流程，用于在DLPNO-CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ级别开发势能面，并应用于含有2到5个水分子的氢氧根-水复合物。该工作流程结合了基于分子轨道的机器学习（MOB-ML）模型和GPU加速的等变图神经网络（EGNN）模型，实现了准确性和效率的双重提升。训练数据通过在每个优化结构上进行的小规模扩散蒙特卡洛（DMC）模拟获得。采用基于主成分分析的最远点采样算法生成涵盖过渡态的多样几何构型。EGNN模型通过将笛卡尔坐标转换为图形表示，消除了对分子构型的额外预处理，提供了对多异构体的无偏处理，并允许异构体之间的异构化过程。对最终EGNN模型进行了误差分析，比较了优化结构、过渡态和从大规模采样的基态波函数快照获得的结构的预测势能。

items.title: Understanding the Structure and Assembly of Dense, Solvent-Free Cellulose Derivatives through Atomistic Force-Field Comparisons
items.abstract: Cellulose and its derivatives are promising sustainable alternatives to conventional synthetic polymers due to their abundance, renewability, and biodegradability. However, how molecular-scale interactions–particularly hydrogen bonding (H-bond) and van der Waals (vdW) interactionsand the conformational behavior of cellulose chains govern their hierarchical organization remains poorly understood. Establishing these relationships is essential for the rational design and predictive modeling of cellulose-based materials. In this work, we investigate the structural organization and self-assembly of bulk cellulose and its derivatives using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. We study systems of up to one million atoms with cumulative trajectories exceeding 25 µs, covering amorphous, semi-crystalline, and a preassembled-crystalline-cellulose test case, as well as amorphous cellulose acetate and carboxymethyl cellulose. To elucidate the cellulose assembly, we compare three widely used all-atom force-fields–GLYCAM06, OPLS-AA, and GROMOS-54a7–and analyze conformations, backbone-twist persistence, H-bond dynamics, chain packing, and crystallization. By linking microscopic structural and dynamical features to macroscopic polymer organization, this work provides molecular insight into cellulose self-assembly and systematically benchmark the ability of the three force-fields to reproduce key structural properties of carbohydrate-based materials.
items.authors: Debashish Mukherji, Tiago Espinosa de Oliveira, Marcus Müller
items.title_zh: 通过原子力场比较理解无溶剂纤维素衍生物的结构与组装
items.summary_zh: 纤维素及其衍生物因其丰富性、可再生性和生物降解性，成为传统合成聚合物的可持续替代品。然而，分子尺度的相互作用，特别是氢键和范德华相互作用如何影响纤维素链的层次组织尚不清楚。本研究通过大规模分子动力学模拟，探讨了块状纤维素及其衍生物的结构组织和自组装。我们研究了高达一百万个原子的系统，累计轨迹超过25微秒，涵盖无定形、半结晶和预组装结晶纤维素，以及无定形纤维素醋酸酯和羧甲基纤维素。通过比较三种广泛使用的全原子力场（GLYCAM06、OPLS-AA和GROMOS-54a7），分析了构象、主链扭转持久性、氢键动力学、链堆积和结晶，揭示了纤维素自组装的分子机制，并系统评估了三种力场的表现。

items.title: An Efficient Temperature-Jump Method for the Calculation of Heat Capacities
items.abstract: We demonstrate a new method for calculating the heat capacity of molecular systems by means of highly parallel molecular dynamics simulations. In an approach using dynamical non-equilibrium molecular dynamics, a temperature perturbation is applied to the system, enabling enhanced sampling of equilibrium phase space. Calculation of the isochoric heat capacity of TIP3P is used as an example to validate this method.
items.authors: Josh Dunn, Andrew R. McCluskey, A. Sofia F. Oliveira, Neil L. Allan, Adrian J. Mulholland
items.title_zh: 高效温度跃迁法计算热容
items.summary_zh: 我们展示了一种通过高度并行的分子动力学模拟计算分子系统热容的新方法。该方法采用动态非平衡分子动力学，对系统施加温度扰动，从而增强平衡相空间的采样。以TIP3P的等容热容计算为例，验证了该方法的有效性。

items.title: Tracking Evolution of Reactive Species in Pellets During HyDR through combined X-ray and Neutron Imaging
items.abstract: Steel production emits 3.6 Gtyr −1 of CO 2 , and the majority of these emissions come from a single step: ironmaking. Hydrogen-based direct reduction (HyDR) offers a lowemission alternative, producing H 2 O instead of CO 2 when operated with green H 2 . Though conceptualized in the 1930s, market adoption of HyDR remains limited due to reactor failures from sticking of iron-ore pellets. The sticking phenomenon is rooted in rate-limiting kinetics, where transport of reactive species competes with surface reaction to become the dominant process. We combine X-ray and neutron imaging to simultaneously resolve microscale pore network evolution and the spatial distribution of reactive species in two iron ore pellets, one non-fractured and one fractured, across three stages of reduction. We detect a consistent accumulation of hydrogenous species on the surface and interior of both pellets across all timepoints. Pellet pores 10 2 µm, do not contribute to this accumulation, marking regions of efficient mass transport. Within the pellet interior, hydrogenous species are spotted in the pellet matrix and at pore boundaries. Isolated pore boundaries have up to 3× higher enrichment of hydrogenous species than the largest connected pore cluster, marking them as regions of poor mass transport. By quantifying permeability, diffusivity, and tortuosity, we show that improved bulk transport with reduction progress does not mitigate local trapping. Our findings connect hydrogenous species retention to pore network evolution and mass transport behavior. Insights from this study provide a basis for microstructural design strategies that could boost transport of reactive species and improve HyDR reactor performance.
items.authors: Subhechchha Paul, Zipeng Xu, Maha Yusuf, Zane Taylor, Anders Kaestner, Sergio Soria
items.title_zh: 通过结合X射线和中子成像追踪氢还原过程中颗粒反应物种的演变
items.summary_zh: 钢铁生产每年排放3.6亿吨CO₂，主要来自炼铁过程。基于氢的直接还原（HyDR）提供了一种低排放的替代方案，使用绿色氢气时产生H₂O而非CO₂。尽管在1930年代就已构思，HyDR的市场应用仍受限于铁矿石颗粒的粘结现象。该现象源于速率限制动力学，反应物种的运输与表面反应竞争。我们结合X射线和中子成像，研究了两种铁矿石颗粒（一个未破裂，一个破裂）在三个还原阶段的微观孔隙网络演变及反应物种的空间分布。我们发现，在所有时间点，两种颗粒的表面和内部均有氢物种的持续积累。直径为10²微米的颗粒孔隙未对这种积累产生贡献，标志着有效的物质运输区域。在颗粒内部，氢物种出现在颗粒基质和孔边界，孤立的孔边界氢物种的富集程度是最大连接孔簇的3倍，标志着物质运输不良区域。通过量化渗透率、扩散率和曲折度，我们展示了改善的整体运输特性。

items.title: 2-Azabicyclo[3.n.1]alkanes as Piperidine Bioisosteres
items.abstract: 2,3- and 2,4-Disubstituted 2-azabicyclo[3.n.1]alkanes (n = 1, 2) are introduced as bioisosteres of 1,2- and 1,3-disubstituted piperidines, respectively. The 2-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptane and 2-azabicyclo[3.2.1]octane cores were constructed in a single step by a scalable intramolecular carbene N–H insertion, with subsequent functionalization giving α- and β-amino acids and other bifunctional derivatives amenable to two-point diversification. Structural analysis of the disubstituted 2-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptane derivatives showed that both substitution patterns matched their reference piperidines in all exit vector parameters but one, and in that one occupied a geometry not observed for the parent ring. Virtual decoration of the functional groups on both 2-azabicyclo[3.n.1]alkane cores gave a library whose calculated physicochemical property profile coincided with that of the monocyclic reference, except for a modest increase in molecular weight. To validate the bioisosteric replacement in a biological context, conformationally restricted bupivacaine analogs based on both cores were prepared and evaluated in the mouse tail-flick assay. The 2-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptane derivative reproduced the antinociceptive effect ofthe reference drug throughout the observation period, whereas the 2-azabicyclo[3.2.1]octane-derived counterpart retained only part ofthe reference activity.
items.authors: Maksym V. Leonenko, Ihor M. Fesun, Illia O. Doroshenko, Mykhailo I. Adamovskyi, Iryna Pishel, Serhii Martseniuk
items.title_zh: 2-氮杂双环[3.n.1]烷烃作为哌啶的生物等排体
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了2,3-和2,4-二取代的2-氮杂双环[3.n.1]烷烃（n = 1, 2）作为1,2-和1,3-二取代哌啶的生物等排体。通过可扩展的分子内碳烯N-H插入反应，构建了2-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷和2-氮杂双环[3.2.1]辛烷核心，随后功能化生成α-和β-氨基酸及其他适合双点多样化的双功能衍生物。对二取代2-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷衍生物的结构分析显示，除了一个参数外，所有取代模式与参考哌啶匹配，而该参数的几何构型在母环中未观察到。对两种2-氮杂双环[3.n.1]烷烃核心的功能团进行虚拟装饰，得到的库的计算物理化学性质与单环参考物相符，分子量仅略有增加。为验证生物等排体替代的生物学背景，基于两种核心制备了构象受限的布比卡因类似物，并在小鼠尾抽动实验中评估。2-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷衍生物在观察期内再现了参考药物的镇痛效果，而2-氮杂双环[3.2.1]辛烷衍生物仅保留了部分参考活性。

items.title: Elucidating Secondary Coordination Sphere Effects on the Electronic Structure and Redox Properties of Biomimetic Iron–Sulfur Cubanes
items.abstract: Nature readily employs iron–sulfur (Fe–S) clusters to perform a wide range of essential biological processes involving long-range electron transport and catalysis for kinetically challenging redox chemistry. Notably, the structure of Fe–S cubane ([Fe4S4]) metalloclusters that serve as electron transfer mediators are highly conserved, where ligand coordination to four cysteine residues anchors the cofactor within metalloproteins such as ferredoxins (Fds) and high-potential iron-sulfur protein (HiPIPs). Despite sharing the same primary coordination environment, the [Fe4S4] cofactors within Fds and HiPIPs operate with discrete redox couples and potential windows that afford distinct electrochemical properties depending on the Fe–S secondary coordination sphere and protein environment. This enables [Fe4S4] clusters to serve as versatile coupling partners for kinetically challenging redox reactions spanning the full range of biologically accessible reduction potentials. The electrochemical properties of [Fe4S4] clusters are tuned through the cooperative interplay between its strongly-correlated electronic structure and the noncovalent interactions within its secondary-sphere and protein environments. Significant experimental and computational efforts have been made to identify the structure-function relationships driving selective modulation of cluster electrochemical features; however, disentangling this complex interplay remains a significant challenge. Here, we employ a low-scaling, multi-reference computational approach to elucidate how secondary-sphere interactions, namely hydrogen bonding (H-bonding) and solvent electrostatics, tune the electronic structure of biomimetic [Fe4S4] clusters and give rise to the diverging redox properties observed across different protein scaffolds in biological systems.
items.authors: Shelby T. Davis, Jan-Niklas Boyn
items.title_zh: 阐明生物仿制铁-硫立方体的次级配位球效应
items.summary_zh: 自然界利用铁-硫（Fe-S）簇执行多种重要生物过程，包括长程电子传输和催化动力学挑战的氧化还原化学。Fe-S 立方体（[Fe4S4]）的结构高度保守，配体与四个半胱氨酸残基的配位将辅因子固定在如铁氧还蛋白（Fds）和高电位铁-硫蛋白（HiPIPs）等金属蛋白中。尽管具有相同的主要配位环境，但Fds和HiPIPs中的[Fe4S4]辅因子在不同的氧化还原对和电位窗口下运作，展现出不同的电化学特性，这取决于Fe-S次级配位球和蛋白环境。通过强相关的电子结构与次级配位球及蛋白环境中的非共价相互作用的协同作用，调节[Fe4S4]簇的电化学特性。大量实验和计算工作致力于识别驱动簇电化学特征选择性调制的结构-功能关系。

items.title: NanoFTIR spectroscopy probes solvation electrostatics in nanoconfinement
items.abstract: The structure and electrostatics of liquids change dramatically under nanometric confinement, suggesting that solvent-solute interactions in such environments differ fundamentally from those in the bulk. Here, we combine nanoscale Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (nanoFTIR) with the vibrational Stark effect (VSE) to directly map the local electric field experienced by a molecular probe—the C=O stretching vibration of dimethylformamide (DMF)—within buried nanofluidic channels. To this end, we fabricated hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-capped trenches with depths ranging from ~100 nm down to 2.6 nm and filled them with a 1:1 (v/v) aqueous DMF solution. Under the strongest confinement (2.6 nm), the DMF C=O stretching mode exhibits a +17 cm -1 blueshift, corresponding to a substantial change in the local solvation electric field strength of 0.39 V Å -1 . Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, combined with MD-derived IR spectra, reproduce the observed spectral shift and the associated change in local solvation electrostatics. The simulations further reveal the emergence of a quasi-phase-separated interfacial layer under finite-size confinement as the origin for the altered electrostatics. Together, these results establish nanoFTIR-based VSE spectroscopy as a direct and quantitative probe of nanosolvation electrostatics in nanoscale fluidic reactors.
items.authors: Leonard Pfister, Sviatoslav Kovalchuk, Oguzhan Yüzel, Kirill Bolotin, Joachim Heberle, Jacek Kozuch
items.title_zh: 纳米FTIR光谱探测纳米限制中的溶剂电静力学
items.summary_zh: 液体在纳米尺度限制下的结构和电静力学发生显著变化，表明此环境中的溶剂-溶质相互作用与体相中有根本性差异。本文结合纳米尺度傅里叶变换红外光谱（nanoFTIR）与振动斯塔克效应（VSE），直接映射埋藏纳米流体通道中分子探针（N,N-二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的C=O伸缩振动）所经历的局部电场。我们制造了深度从约100 nm到2.6 nm的六方氮化硼（hBN）封闭沟槽，并用1:1（v/v）的水性DMF溶液填充。在最强限制（2.6 nm）下，DMF的C=O伸缩模式表现出+17 cm -1的蓝移，对应局部溶剂电场强度的显著变化（0.39 V Å -1）。分子动力学（MD）模拟结合MD导出的红外光谱再现了观察到的光谱偏移及局部溶剂电静力学的变化，进一步揭示了有限尺寸限制下准相分离界面层的出现是电静力学改变的来源。这些结果确立了基于nanoFTIR的VSE光谱作为纳米流体反应器中纳米溶剂电静力学的直接定量探测工具。

items.title: Environmental footprint of High-Throughput Screening technologies for enzyme discovery and engineering: a Life Cycle Assessment comparison
items.abstract: High-throughput screening (HTS) is widely used in enzyme discovery and engineering towards developing more sustainable industrial processes and environmental applications, yet it is a plastic intensive approach whose environmental performance has been rarely assessed quantitatively. Here, we conducted a comparative cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment (LCA) among four representative screening technologies to assay 1 million enzymes or enzyme variants: a pipettingbased liquid handling robot in 384-well plates (P-LHR 384 wp), an acoustic liquid handler in 1536-well plates (A-LHR 1536 wp), agar-based screening, and droplet microfluidics. Primary inventory data were compiled for reagents, plastics, and electricity consumption and translated into 16 Environmental Footprint (EF) impact categories. Droplet microfluidics consistently showed the lowest impacts nearly across the 16 EF indicators, typically by 1–3 orders of magnitude relative to conventional plate-based robotics. For climate change, droplet microfluidics reached 1.3 kg CO 2 eq per million assays, compared with 1381 kg CO 2 eq for P-LHR 384 wp, 150 kg CO 2 eq for A-LHR 1536 wp and 56 kg CO 2 eq for agar-based assays. The lower environmental impacts of droplet microfluidics emerged from extreme assay miniaturization and nearelimination of plastic disposables, shifting the impact contribution burden mainly to electricity use. A parallel cost analysis showed the same trend, from 850,000 € for P-LHR 384 wp to ~20 € for droplet microfluidics. These results identify reaction miniaturization, plastic reduction, and decarbonized electricity as the primary drivers for sustainable HTS enzyme discovery.
items.authors: Pablo Rodríguez-Mateos, Javier Sáez-Guinoa, Sara Lago-Olveira, Aurelio Hidalgo
items.title_zh: 高通量筛选技术的环境足迹：生命周期评估比较
items.summary_zh: 高通量筛选（HTS）广泛应用于酶的发现与工程，以开发更可持续的工业过程和环境应用，但其环境表现鲜有定量评估。本文对四种代表性筛选技术进行了比较生命周期评估（LCA），以检测100万个酶或酶变体：384孔板的液体处理机器人（P-LHR 384 wp）、1536孔板的声学液体处理器（A-LHR 1536 wp）、琼脂基筛选和液滴微流体技术。我们收集了试剂、塑料和电力消耗的初步清单数据，并转化为16个环境足迹（EF）影响类别。液滴微流体技术在16个EF指标中几乎始终显示出最低的影响，通常比传统的基于板的机器人低1-3个数量级。在气候变化方面，液滴微流体技术每百万次检测的碳排放为1.3 kg CO2当量，而P-LHR 384 wp为1381 kg CO2当量，A-LHR 1536 wp为150 kg CO2当量，琼脂基检测为56 kg CO2当量。液滴微流体技术的环境影响较低源于极小化检测和几乎消除塑料一次性用品，主要将影响转移至电力使用。

items.title: Redox-Metered Paired Electrolysis: A Strategy for Comprehensive Deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) Cross-Coupling
items.abstract: Interfacing transition metal catalysts with radical intermediates is a powerful paradigm for organic synthesis; however, it often requires the precise synchronization of independent catalytic cycles, and this requirement can limit scope and generality. We report a novel electrochemical strategy, which we term “redox-metered paired electrolysis,” in which the formation of a radical precursor in situ gates the rate of activation of its intended partner, thus promoting efficient cross-coupling across diverse substrate classes. We apply this strategy to the deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) cross-coupling of primary alkyl amines and aryl electrophiles, facilitated by the design of a bench-stable, dihydropyridine activating group. Notably, our redox-metered approach enables the cross-coupling of four categories of amines with five classes of aryl electrophiles—triflates, chlorides, bromides, iodides, and activated carboxylic acids—all under one unified set of conditions. Nineteen total pairs of amine and aryl electrophile classes are demonstrated to undergo catalytic cross-coupling ( 75 examples), including seven that have not been reported previously. These novel pairs include elusive, yet valuable bond formations, such as the deaminative cross-coupling of phenol-derived aryl triflates with amines and the coupling of aryl halides with α-amino acids. Time course analysis supports the proposed mechanism and reveals design principles for future applications of this strategy.
items.authors: Emma N. George, Mariah C. Castillo, Johnny Z. Wang, Chiyoung Ahn, Colin A. Gould
items.title_zh: 红氧计量配对电解：全面的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联策略
items.summary_zh: 将过渡金属催化剂与自由基中间体相结合是一种强大的有机合成范式，但通常需要独立催化循环的精确同步，这限制了其适用范围和普遍性。我们报告了一种新颖的电化学策略，称为“红氧计量配对电解”，通过原位生成自由基前体来调控其目标反应物的活化速率，从而促进不同底物类别的高效交叉偶联。我们将该策略应用于初级烷基胺与芳基电亲体的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联，设计了一个稳定的二氢吡啶活化基团。值得注意的是，我们的红氧计量方法使四类胺与五类芳基电亲体（包括三氟甲磺酸酯、氯、溴、碘及活化羧酸）在统一条件下实现交叉偶联。共展示了十九对胺和芳基电亲体类别的催化交叉偶联（75个实例），其中七个为首次报道。这些新颖的配对包括难以获得但有价值的键形成，如酚衍生芳基三氟甲磺酸酯与胺的去氨基交叉偶联及芳基卤化物与α-氨基酸的偶联。时间进程分析支持了这一提议。

items.title: Reaction-orthogonal solid-state reference enables potentiometric studies of vapor phase thermochemical catalysis
items.abstract: Electrochemical mechanisms have been shown to be operative in the catalysis of numerous thermochemical redox reactions. These mechanisms have been elucidated by the measurement of the electrochemical potential of the catalyst during turnover (E cat ). A rich array of electrochemical tools allows for measurement of E cat during liquid-phase catalysis, but these are ill-suited to E cat measurements in higher temperature vapor-phase catalysis. Herein we report a solid electrolyte potentiometry (SEP) methodology that employs a Na β″-alumina solid electrolyte to measure E cat relative to the Na/Na + reference couple. As Na + is not typically a reactant or product in (electro)catalytic reactions, this reference is reaction-orthogonal, providing a common reference value for E cat measurement and analysis across diverse reaction classes and environments. Reaction-orthogonal SEP (RO-SEP) of Pt/C under H 2 enables measurement of the H 2 /H + equilibrium potential in the vapor phase across a wide temperature range from ambient to 325 °C. We find that promoting salts establish vapor phase proton activities comparable to their values in bulk aqueous medium, at ambient temperature. We apply RO-SEP to study the Au/C-catalyzed aerobic oxidation of 2-propanol to acetone and find that the catalyst is spontaneously and differentially polarized as a function of O 2 pressure under vapor phase reaction conditions. Simultaneous measurement of rate and E cat reveals a rate-potential scaling for vapor phase aerobic IPA oxidation that parallels that of liquid phase electrolytic IPA oxidation, suggesting a shared electrochemical mechanism between the two conditions. Lastly, H 2 /H + potentiometry reveals that alkali promoters in this reaction act principally via increasing the pH at the catalyst surface, which in turn enhances the kinetics of both the oxygen reduction and 2-propanol oxidation half-reaction. This reaction-orthogonal methodology for quantifying E cat enables broad-based investigations into the role of charge transfer in vapor phase heterogeneous catalysis.
items.authors: Deiaa M. Harraz, Cole S. Cadaram, Kunal M. Lodaya, Bryan Y. Tang, Yogesh Surendranath
items.title_zh: 反应正交固态参考实现气相热化学催化的电位测量
items.summary_zh: 电化学机制在众多热化学氧还原反应的催化中发挥作用。通过测量催化剂在反应过程中的电化学电位（E cat），可以阐明这些机制。尽管现有的电化学工具能够在液相催化中测量E cat，但在高温气相催化中则不适用。本文报告了一种固体电解质电位法（SEP），利用Na β″-铝酸盐固体电解质相对于Na/Na +参考对E cat进行测量。由于Na +通常不是电催化反应中的反应物或产物，该参考具有反应正交性，为不同反应类别和环境中的E cat测量提供了共同的参考值。我们在H 2气氛下对Pt/C进行反应正交SEP（RO-SEP），测量了气相中H 2 /H +的平衡电位，温度范围从常温到325 °C。研究发现，促进盐在气相中建立的质子活性与其在水相中的值相当。我们应用RO-SEP研究了Au/C催化的2-丙醇的有氧氧化反应，发现催化剂在气相反应中会自发且差异性地极化，具体取决于O 2压力。

items.title: The Core Matters: Aggregation of Neutral Ligand-Coated Nanoparticles in Membranes
items.abstract: The aggregation of gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) influences their optical properties, including localized surface plasmon resonance, through plasmonic coupling between adjacent particles. For hydrophobic AuNPs embedded in lipid membranes, however, the mechanisms governing aggregation remain poorly understood. Although coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations are well suited to study these processes, commonly used ligand–nanoparticle (NP) models neglect explicit core interactions. Here, we test whether core properties regulate NP aggregation by simulating multiple Martini NP models in a membrane environment. In contrast to the assumption that surface ligands effectively shield the core, we find that interactions with the environment remain sensitive to core parameters even at maximum ligand coverage. Furthermore, core–solvent interactions are consistent with a mechanism that directly drives nanoparticle aggregation. These results suggest that core interactions can contribute to the aggregation of functionalized nanoparticles.
items.authors: Jahmal J. Ennis, Julianne C. Griepenburg, Grace Brannigan
items.title_zh: 核心影响：中性配体涂层纳米颗粒在膜中的聚集
items.summary_zh: 金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）的聚集影响其光学性质，包括局部表面等离子体共振，主要通过相邻颗粒之间的等离子体耦合。然而，对于嵌入脂质膜中的疏水性AuNPs，聚集机制仍不清楚。尽管粗粒度分子动力学模拟适合研究这些过程，但常用的配体-纳米颗粒模型忽略了核心的显式相互作用。本文通过在膜环境中模拟多种Martini纳米颗粒模型，测试核心特性是否调节纳米颗粒聚集。与表面配体有效屏蔽核心的假设相反，我们发现即使在最大配体覆盖下，环境与核心参数的相互作用仍然敏感。此外，核心-溶剂相互作用与直接驱动纳米颗粒聚集的机制一致。这些结果表明，核心相互作用可能对功能化纳米颗粒的聚集产生影响。

items.title: A benchmark dataset of 86 intermolecular interactions of neutrals, ions, radicals and radical ions with water and hydrogen sulfide
items.abstract: Guiding the selection of modern density functional approximations (DFAs) for intermolecular interactions requires diverse benchmark assessments. This work reports the development of a new test set of 86 binary complexes formed between either H 2 O or H 2 S and 31 selected partner species, comprising 15 neutral closed-shell molecules, 7 neutral radicals, 4 closed-shell anions, 2 closed-shell cations, and 3 cation radicals. The radical complexes are susceptible to delocalization error, while the interaction strengths span weak to very strong. Benchmark results are obtained at the coupled cluster singles, doubles and perturbative triples, CCSD(T), level, extrapolated towards the complete basis set limit from augmented triple and quadruple zeta basis calculations. This data is used to assess 17 different density functionals, spanning rungs 2 through 5 of Jacob’s Ladder. In common with other benchmarks, we find that the best functional on each higher rung of Jacob’s Ladder improves over the rung below, consistent with the potential to reduce the delocalization error. Only one functional, the ωB97M(2) double hybrid, achieves an RMS error of less than 1 kcal/mol. The best-performing hybrid is the recently introduced COACH functional, which has an RMS error just below 2 kcal/mol, while the best-performing meta-GGA and GGA have RMS errors above 3 and 4 kcal/mol respectively. These errors are dominated by the complexes that involve radical ions or neutral radicals. While the best-performing functionals are useful, these results indicate that further progress is still needed to address the delocalization error in intermolecular interactions.
items.authors: Rebecca Tomann, Partha P. Bera, Martin Head-Gordon
items.title_zh: 86种中性、离子、自由基及自由基离子与水和硫化氢的相互作用基准数据集
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一个新的测试集，包含86个由水（H₂O）或硫化氢（H₂S）与31种选择的伴侣物种形成的二元复合物。这些伴侣物种包括15种中性闭壳层分子、7种中性自由基、4种闭壳层阴离子、2种闭壳层阳离子和3种阳离子自由基。自由基复合物易受去局域化误差影响，且相互作用强度从弱到非常强不等。基准结果在耦合簇单、双和微扰三重（CCSD(T)）水平上获得，并通过增强的三重和四重ζ基组计算向完整基组极限外推。该数据用于评估17种不同的密度泛函，涵盖雅各布阶梯的第2至第5级。结果显示，每个更高阶梯的最佳泛函在降低去局域化误差方面优于下一级。仅有ωB97M(2)双杂化泛函的均方根误差低于1 kcal/mol，而新引入的COACH泛函表现最佳，均方根误差略低于2 kcal/mol。表现最佳的meta-GGA和GGA的均方根误差分别超过3和4 kcal/mol。

items.title: ML26: New Ingredients for an Integral-Features Density Functional with Broad Chemical Accuracy
items.abstract: Integral-features density functional theory (IF-DFT) replaces the conventional integration over local ingredients with a nonlinear mapping from global integral descriptors, enabling machine-learned density functionals with broad transferability. Here we report ML26@MN15, a new IF functional that extends the earlier ML25@MN15 model by incorporating 12 additional correlation features—including overlap-projected rung-3.5 terms, CS1 dynamic-correlation ingredients, and VV10 nonlocal correlation—and by treating Hartree–Fock exchange as an integral feature rather than as a fixed hybrid percentage. ML26@MN15 employs 79 integral features evaluated on MN15 ingredients and a single-hidden-layer neural network with 5000 nodes to produce a size-extensive exchange–correlation energy. Trained on 185 databases comprising 7242 reference data, ML26@MN15 achieves a data-averaged energetic mean unsigned error of 0.89 kcal/mol, improving upon ML25@MN15 by 15% and outperforming a group of previous leading functionals across all eight chemical partitions examined. For the widely used MDB2019S, MGCDB84, and GMTKN55 datasets, ML26@MN15 yields the lowest averaged error among all tested functionals, including the results for GMTKN55 by ML-based Skala-1.1 and DM21 density functional approximations. The new functional also maintains strong performance for systems containing heavy elements and exhibits improved behavior on a challenging self-interaction benchmark. These results show that expanding the integral-feature space with physically motivated nonlocal ingredients yields a density functional with unprecedented accuracy across diverse chemical benchmarks. The broad and consistent accuracy of ML26@MN15 highlights the promise of integral-features density functional approximations as a scalable framework for incorporating additional nonlocal physics into future functional development.
items.authors: Dayou Zhang, Yinan Shu, Benjamin G. Janesko, Donald G. Truhlar
items.title_zh: ML26：具有广泛化学准确性的积分特征密度泛函新成分
items.summary_zh: 积分特征密度泛函理论（IF-DFT）通过从全局积分描述符进行非线性映射，取代了传统的局部成分积分，从而实现了具有广泛可转移性的机器学习密度泛函。本文报告了ML26@MN15，这是一种新的IF泛函，通过引入12个额外的相关特征（包括重叠投影的3.5级项、CS1动态相关成分和VV10非局部相关），并将哈特里-福克交换视为积分特征，而非固定混合百分比，扩展了早期的ML25@MN15模型。ML26@MN15使用79个在MN15成分上评估的积分特征和一个具有5000个节点的单隐层神经网络，生成规模广泛的交换-相关能量。经过185个数据库（共7242个参考数据）的训练，ML26@MN15实现了0.89 kcal/mol的数据平均能量无符号误差，比ML25@MN15提高了15%，并在所有八个化学分区中超越了一组先前的领先泛函。在广泛使用的MDB2019S、MGCDB84和GMTKN55数据集中，ML26@MN15在所有测试的泛函中产生了最低的平均误差。

items.title: Molecular Origins of Site-Specific CO2 Absorption in Hydrated Deep Eutectic Solvents
items.abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as promising candidates for CO 2 capture because of their highly tunable structures and CO 2 absorption capacities. However, their behavior under practical operating conditions remains poorly understood. In particular, the effect of water on DES structure and their CO 2 absorption capacity remains unclear. In this work, we use free energy perturbation (FEP) and molecular simulations to determine the CO 2 absorption capacities and transport properties of hydrated hydrophilic and hydrophobic DESs. Our results show that increasing water concentration decreases viscosity but also makes CO 2 solvation less favorable in both DESs, revealing a trade-off between transport properties and CO 2 absorption capacity. This trade-off is more favorable for the hydrophobic DES, which shows a substantial reduction in viscosity while maintaining a negative CO 2 solvation free energy. In contrast, the solvation free energy of the hydrophilic DES increases more substantially, becoming positive at 15 wt% H 2 O. Structural analysis reveals that these differences arise from distinct hydration and CO 2 solvation mechanisms in the two DESs. In the hydrophilic DES, CO 2 preferentially localizes around the Br – anion under dry conditions. Upon hydration, water blocks the anionic site, and the preferred CO 2 solvation site shifts to the cation.
items.authors: Deepak Kumar Panda, Soumik Das, Salman A. Khan
items.title_zh: 水合深共熔溶剂中CO2吸收的分子起源
items.summary_zh: 深共熔溶剂（DES）因其高度可调的结构和CO2吸收能力而成为捕集CO2的有前景候选者。然而，它们在实际操作条件下的行为仍不清楚，尤其是水对DES结构及其CO2吸收能力的影响。本研究采用自由能扰动（FEP）和分子模拟方法，确定了水合亲水性和疏水性DES的CO2吸收能力和传输特性。结果表明，增加水浓度降低了粘度，但也使得两种DES中的CO2溶剂化变得不利，显示出传输特性与CO2吸收能力之间的权衡。疏水性DES在保持负的CO2溶剂化自由能的同时，粘度显著降低，而亲水性DES的溶剂化自由能则显著增加，在15 wt% H2O时变为正值。结构分析表明，这些差异源于两种DES中不同的水合和CO2溶剂化机制。

items.title: Transport-guided intensification of plasma activation spray for scalable and tunable water treatment
items.abstract: Interaction of cold plasma with aqueous media underpins emerging technologies in water treatment, chemical conversion, and biomedicine, yet scalable plasma-liquid activation remains limited by inefficient gas-liquid mass transfer and rapid reactive-species decay. This study reports a droplet-based plasma activation spray (PAS) reactor and establishes transport-guided design principles for intensifying reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) capture. Through systematic variation in spray-nozzle size, chamber geometry, and gas flow, we identify regimes governing the magnitude and composition of plasma activation. Smaller droplets (∼342 µm) favored reactive nitrogen species uptake through increased interfacial area, whereas larger droplets (∼1.3 mm) accumulated hydrogen peroxide through bulk-phase retention. Larger chambers extended droplet flight time and enhanced bulk accumulation, while positioning electrodes near the liquid interface minimized short-lived species transport losses. Spatial repositioning of multiple needles further improved the plasma activation by covering inactive zones. These design principles, validated in scaled PAS systems, achieved peak energy yields ( 1.84 mmol/MJ at liter-scale) and enabled rapid antibiotic degradation and superior ≥ 5-log microbial inactivation, bridging the gap between plasma science and large-scale environmental application. The results position PAS as a tunable and scalable platform, providing a robust engineering framework that couples plasma physics with droplet hydrodynamics for high-throughput water activation.
items.authors: Hon Man Luk, Deepak Panchal, Qiuyun Lu, Siyu Chen, Xuehua Zhang
items.title_zh: 运输引导的等离子体激活喷雾强化水处理技术
items.summary_zh: 冷等离子体与水介质的相互作用是水处理、化学转化和生物医学等新兴技术的基础，但可扩展的等离子体-液体激活受到气-液传质效率低和反应物种快速衰减的限制。本研究报告了一种基于液滴的等离子体激活喷雾（PAS）反应器，并建立了运输引导的设计原则以增强活性氧和氮物种（RONS）的捕获。通过系统改变喷嘴尺寸、腔体几何形状和气体流动，我们识别了影响等离子体激活强度和组成的不同机制。较小的液滴（∼342 µm）通过增加界面面积促进了活性氮物种的吸收，而较大的液滴（∼1.3 mm）则通过体相保留积累了过氧化氢。较大的腔体延长了液滴飞行时间并增强了体相积累，同时将电极靠近液体界面可最小化短寿命物种的传输损失。多个针头的空间重新定位进一步改善了等离子体激活，覆盖了非活跃区域。这些在扩展的PAS系统中验证的设计原则实现了峰值能量产率（1.84 mmol/MJ，升级规模），并促进了快速抗生素降解和优越的≥5-log微生物灭活，缩小了等离子体科学与大规模环境应用之间的差距。

items.title: Hyperlocal Sensing and Inverse Modeling Reveal Community Impacts of Urban Air Pollutant Emissions
items.abstract: Addressing urban air pollution requires identifying, quantifying, and mitigating emission sources, yet bottom-up inventories often lack fine spatiotemporal precision and rarely capture unpermitted or informally operated sources. We combine dense mobile and fixed-site measurements in a Bayesian inverse modeling framework to produce hourly, hyperlocal black carbon (BC) emission maps (150 m × 150 m) that reveal how and where key sources are underrepresented. In West Oakland, CA — an overburdened community near major freight infrastructure — our approach identifies underestimated and unaccounted emission sources, increasing estimated BC emissions by ~33%. These corrections quadruple the contribution of neighborhood and port-related sources to population-weighted exposures (from 5 to 20%), disproportionately affecting low-income neighborhoods adjacent to freight corridors. Our results demonstrate that combining dense observational data with inverse modeling enables detection and quantification of overlooked emissions, supporting targeted intervention. Sensitivity analyses indicate similar performance with a substantially reduced fixed-site network (~10 monitors; ~1 site / km 2 , compared with 6.7 sites/km 2 in the full campaign), paired with time-averaged mobile maps, supporting applicability in data-limited urban settings.
items.authors: Chirag Manchanda, Ronald Cohen, Ramon Alvarez, Tammy Thompson, Maria Harris, Alexander Turner
items.title_zh: 超局部感知与反演建模揭示城市空气污染排放的社区影响
items.summary_zh: 应对城市空气污染需要识别、量化和减轻排放源，但自下而上的清单往往缺乏精细的时空精度，且很少捕捉到未获许可或非正式运营的源。我们结合密集的移动和固定测量数据，在贝叶斯反演建模框架中生成每小时超局部黑碳（BC）排放地图（150米×150米），揭示关键源的低估情况。在加州西奥克兰这一靠近主要货运基础设施的过度负担社区中，我们的方法识别出低估和未考虑的排放源，使黑碳排放估计增加约33%。这些修正使邻里和港口相关源对加权人口暴露的贡献增加四倍（从5%增至20%），不成比例地影响靠近货运走廊的低收入社区。我们的结果表明，结合密集观测数据与反演建模能够检测和量化被忽视的排放，支持有针对性的干预。敏感性分析表明，使用大幅减少的固定站网络（约10个监测器；约1个站点/km²，与完整项目的6.7个站点/km²相比）与时间平均的移动地图结合，仍能实现类似的效果，支持在数据有限的城市环境中的适用性。

items.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
items.abstract: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the individual GNNs or ChemBERTa-only models. Random splitting on the RF model exhibits a better R2 score than on a scaffold-split dataset. Because under scaffold splitting the model predicts on unseen cores, the task becomes more difficult than under regular random splitting.
items.authors: Pradyumna Kumar Pradhan
items.title_zh: 基于支架分割的血浆蛋白结合预测：树模型、ChemBERTa与图网络
items.summary_zh: 药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程，科学家通过机器学习和人工智能优先选择更有可能成功的分子。本研究使用DeepChem的MoleculeNet中的血浆蛋白结合（PPB）数据集，结合多种图神经网络（GNN）、ChemBERTa（用于分子SMILES字符串的语言模型）及其融合模型。与随机森林（RF）和XGBoost这两种标准树模型进行比较。研究采用支架分割方法，通过Bemis-Murcko支架将分子分离，确保整个组仅进入训练、验证或测试集。结果表明，GNN和ChemBERTa模型在PPB数据集上的表现优于树模型，融合模型的平均表现也优于单独的GNN或ChemBERTa模型。RF模型在随机分割时的R2得分优于支架分割数据集。

items.title: Performance of Highly Coarse-Grained Chain Models with Extremal Measures for a Configuration-Dependent Hydrodynamic Diameter in Rheological Flow Fields
items.abstract: In the presence of fluctuating hydrodynamic interactions (HI), coarse-grained beadspring models are known to show large deviations in rheological predictions relative to finely resolved chain models. In a recent study, we formulated a modified bead-spring approach where the bead hydrodynamic diameter increases proportionally to the mean spring stretch. Significant improvements were observed in the resulting predictions for rheological flow fields for models with many springs. In the new approach, a balanced accuracy across flow types was obtained with the harmonic mean strategy to obtain the mean stretch. In this study, we explore the limits of this approach with highly coarse-grained models consisting of very few springs. Additionally, we test the behavior of two extremal measures to set the bead hydrodynamic diameter. Note, due to the computational complexity with HI, minimizing the number of beads is highly preferable for any application. Surprisingly, our results show the validity of the approach for high degrees of coarse-graining up to only 3 springs, even with the extremal measures, particularly for extensional flows. Predictions in shear flows become better with increasing number of springs, with a good agreement observed with 10 springs.
items.authors: Lokesh Yadav, Praphul Kumar, S. V. Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal
items.title_zh: 极限测量下粗粒链模型在流变场中的表现
items.summary_zh: 在波动的流体动力学相互作用下，粗粒化的珠-弹簧模型相较于精细解析的链模型在流变预测上存在较大偏差。我们提出了一种改进的珠-弹簧方法，使珠的流体动力学直径与平均弹簧拉伸成正比。对于含有多个弹簧的模型，流变流场的预测显著改善。新方法通过调和平均策略获得平均拉伸，实现了不同流动类型的平衡准确性。本研究探讨了该方法在仅由少量弹簧构成的高度粗粒化模型中的局限性，并测试了两种极限测量对珠的流体动力学直径的影响。结果表明，该方法在高粗粒化程度下仍有效，最多可支持3个弹簧，尤其适用于拉伸流动。在剪切流动中，随着弹簧数量的增加，预测结果逐渐改善，10个弹簧时表现良好。

items.title: Cationic Selenuranes Enable Direct Linchpin Formation in Arenes
items.abstract: The formation of linchpins is a powerful strategy for increasing molecular complexity. Chalcogenonium salts have become valuable intermediates for molecular diversification, owing to their exceptional chemoselectivity in arene C–H functionalization and a synthetic versatility comparable to that of halides and pseudohalides. Sulfonium group introduction through an isohypsic process from S(IV) precursors requires activation with strong acids or anhydrides. Here, we report the direct synthesis of selenonium salts from bench-stable Se(III) cationic selenuranes using a simple dump-and-stir protocol. The transformation proceeds under air at ambient temperature and requires no exogenous activators. Mechanistic investigations reveal high sensitivity to electronic effects (ρ = −10), whereas site selectivity is determined by the rate-limiting deprotonation step (kH/kD = 2.3). The method is scalable to 10.0 mmol ( 6.2 g) and provides direct access to selenonium salts derived from complex molecules. The resulting selenonium salts serve as versatile linchpins for photochemical, nucleophilic, and transition-metal-catalyzed transformations, enabling late-stage molecular diversification.
items.authors: Kirill Zhiliaev, Till Schreyer, Mihai V. Popescu, Javier Mateos
items.title_zh: 阳离子硒氨盐实现芳烃中直接连接体的形成
items.summary_zh: 连接体的形成是一种有效的增加分子复杂性的策略。由于其在芳烃C–H功能化中的优异化学选择性，硫族阳离子盐已成为分子多样化的重要中间体。通过S(IV)前体的等高过程引入磺基团需要强酸或酸酐的激活。本文报道了一种从稳定的Se(III)阳离子硒氨盐直接合成硒氨盐的方法，采用简单的倾倒搅拌协议。该转化在常温下的空气中进行，无需外源激活剂。机理研究显示对电子效应高度敏感（ρ = −10），而位点选择性由速率限制的去质子化步骤决定（kH/kD = 2.3）。该方法可扩展至10.0 mmol（6.2 g），并直接获得源自复杂分子的硒氨盐。所得硒氨盐可作为多功能连接体，支持光化学、亲核和过渡金属催化转化，实现后期分子多样化。

items.title: Contrastive Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Goal Directed 3D Molecular Design
items.abstract: Although three-dimensional flow-matching models have become powerful tools for efficient sampling of high-quality 3D molecular structures, reward-based reinforcement learning for flow-matching models is complicated by the absence of a tractable trajectory likelihood for hybrid molecular states comprising categorical features and continuous coordinates. Existing policy-optimization strategies address this difficulty by stochasticizing the generative process or constructing likelihood surrogates, introducing additional approximations. Here, we present ReCoFlow, a novel trajectorylikelihood-free reinforcement learning framework for reward-contrastive post-training of pretrained molecular flow-matching models. Within ReCoFlow, reward-favored molecules provide positive endpoint supervision for the flow-matching model, whereas reward-disfavored molecules are used to construct reference-guided negative targets. Additionally, an anchor loss to an exponential moving average (EMA) reference model constrains the drift of the fine-tuned model. In benchmarking studies including physicochemical property optimization, three-dimensional shape optimization, and pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation, ReCoFlow consistently improved the performance of flow-matching models over reward-weighted and surrogate-ratio optimization schemes while maintaining high molecular validity. These results suggest that ReCoFlow could be an effective reinforcement-learning strategy for goal-directed molecular design.
items.authors: Bohao Li, Yuedong Yang, Mingyuan Xu, Hongming Chen
items.title_zh: 基于对比奖励的目标导向3D分子设计强化学习
items.summary_zh: 三维流匹配模型已成为高效采样高质量3D分子结构的强大工具，但基于奖励的强化学习因缺乏可处理的轨迹似然性而复杂化。现有的策略优化方法通过随机化生成过程或构建似然替代品来解决这一问题，带来了额外的近似。本文提出了ReCoFlow，一种新颖的无轨迹似然性强化学习框架，用于对预训练的分子流匹配模型进行奖励对比后训练。在ReCoFlow中，奖励偏好的分子为流匹配模型提供正向监督，而奖励不偏好的分子用于构建参考引导的负目标。此外，锚损失与指数移动平均（EMA）参考模型的结合限制了微调模型的漂移。在包括物理化学性质优化、三维形状优化和口袋条件3D分子生成的基准研究中，ReCoFlow在保持高分子有效性的同时，持续提升了流匹配模型的性能，优于奖励加权和替代比优化方案。

items.title: Microphase Separation and Water Accessibility in Crosslinked Polyurethanes
items.abstract: Polyurethane materials are among the most widely used synthetic polymers, yet the atomic-scale structural organisation governing their macroscopic properties remains largely elusive. Despite decades of study, the chain organisation of hard and soft domains in polyurethane remains poorly understood because experimental techniques cannot resolve chain packing and intermolecular interactions at atomistic resolution. Here we combine Monte Carlo-based downsampling of chain length distributions fitted to experimental data with an iterative crosslinking protocol coupled to molecular dynamics relaxation to generate fully atomistic models of heterogeneous polymers with varying crosslinking degrees, using toluene diisocyanate (TDI) and propoxylated glycerol-based polyurethane as a model system. The resulting models reproduce available experimental thermodynamic and structural data, and spontaneously develop microphase separated morphologies consistent with experimental observations. The simulations reveal that hard segment aggregation is a major organisational factor driving microphase separation. Within hard domains, interchain NH· · ·O=C hydrogen bonds dominate cohesive interactions, while atomistic resolution reveals aromatic packing motifs consistent with π-π interactions between aromatic rings in both parallel and perpendicular geometries. At the polyurethane-water interface, urea and amine groups are the most solvent-exposed and retain well-defined hydration shells, whereas urethane linkages remain comparatively shielded. Together, these results provide an atomistic account of hard domain formation and microphase separation in polyurethane, and establish how this morphology governs the accessibility of urethane bonds to catalytic cleavage. The approach provides a framework for investigating structure-property relationships in heterogeneous amorphous polymer systems, with potential applications ranging from enzymatic degradation to materials design.
items.authors: Alexandre V. Pinto, Pedro A. Fernandes, Maria J. Ramos
items.title_zh: 交联聚氨酯的微相分离与水的可及性
items.summary_zh: 聚氨酯材料是应用最广泛的合成聚合物之一，但其原子级结构组织对宏观性质的影响仍不清楚。尽管经过数十年的研究，聚氨酯中硬段和软段的链组织仍然不够理解，因为实验技术无法以原子分辨率解析链的堆积和分子间相互作用。本文结合基于蒙特卡罗的链长分布下采样与分子动力学松弛的迭代交联协议，生成具有不同交联度的异质聚合物的全原子模型，以甲苯二异氰酸酯（TDI）和丙氧基化甘油基聚氨酯为模型系统。结果模型再现了现有的热力学和结构数据，并自发形成与实验观察一致的微相分离形态。模拟结果表明，硬段聚集是驱动微相分离的主要组织因素。硬段内，链间的NH· · ·O=C氢键主导了内聚相互作用，而原子分辨率揭示了与芳香环之间的π-π相互作用一致的芳香堆积模式。

items.title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
items.abstract: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms.
items.authors: Shaozhen Ding, Peng Wu, Shubo Li, Yuxuan Yang, Han Zhu, Heng Yu
items.title_zh: 数据驱动的酶工程策略：从机器学习到蛋白质语言模型
items.summary_zh: 酶是推动多种生物过程和工业应用的关键生物催化剂，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，庞大的酶序列空间和有限的功能注释使得加速酶发现和工程的计算方法需求迫切。近期计算方法的进展正在将酶工程从经验试错转向预测设计。本文总结了酶工程工作流程中的代表性计算工具和预测模型，包括（1）酶数据资源，（2）功能酶发现，（3）酶性质预测（如动力学、最佳温度和pH、溶解度、广谱性和特异性），（4）de novo酶设计，以及（5）计算指导的酶优化。我们进一步比较了当前的计算策略，讨论其在不同工程场景中的优缺点，并强调了基础模型、生成性人工智能、多模态学习和闭环设计-构建-测试-学习平台的 emerging trends。

items.title: Accumulation of enzymes on the lipid-oleosin membarnes
items.abstract: Engineering the spatial organization of proteins offers a powerful strategy for controlling biochemical reactions and material properties in synthetic cells. However, dynamically organizing multiple proteins at the nanometer scale remains challenging. We developed asymmetric lipid–oleosin hybrid vesicles in which engineered oleosin molecules served as membrane-forming scaffolds with two orthogonal conjugation systems. External chemical stimuli rapidly recruited two distinct proteins to individual oleosin molecules, generating persistent nanometer-scale proximity, as demonstrated by single-molecule tracking. In an alditol oxidase–horseradish peroxidase cascade, organization of both enzymes on the same oleosin scaffold enhanced product formation compared with intermolecular membrane recruitment. This localized cascade further drove stimulus-responsive polymerization to form membrane-associated cytoskeleton-like structures, increasing vesicle resistance to hypertonic stress. This programmable membrane scaffold couples external signals with molecular organization, enhanced biochemical reactions, and membrane mechanics, providing a framework for engineering synthetic cells that convert chemical inputs into programmable reactions and material outputs.
items.authors: Masato Suzuki, Rinshi S. Kasai, Koki Kamiya
items.title_zh: 脂质-油蛋白膜上酶的积累研究
items.summary_zh: 工程化蛋白质的空间组织为控制合成细胞中的生化反应和材料特性提供了有效策略。然而，在纳米尺度上动态组织多种蛋白质仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了不对称的脂质-油蛋白混合囊泡，其中工程化的油蛋白分子作为膜形成支架，具有两种正交的结合系统。外部化学刺激快速招募两种不同的蛋白质到各自的油蛋白分子上，产生持久的纳米级接近性。通过单分子追踪证明，在醇糖氧化酶-辣根过氧化物酶级联反应中，两个酶在同一油蛋白支架上的组织相比于分子间膜招募增强了产物形成。该局部级联反应进一步驱动刺激响应聚合，形成膜相关的细胞骨架样结构，提高了囊泡对高渗透压的抵抗力。该可编程膜支架将外部信号与分子组织、生化反应和膜力学相结合，为工程化合成细胞提供了将化学输入转化为可编程反应和材料输出的框架。

items.title: Finite-Field Second Hyperpolarizability via Adaptive Bayesian Quantum Phase Estimation for Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers: Ground-State Energies Beyond Chemical Accuracy
